decision: one device, so no fan-out: every device phase runs serially in this session

decision: started the 93-clip sweep, small files first

decision: found the stall cause: an appDataContainer copy hangs while the app is not running, and recovers around 70s when it catches a relaunch
why: three bare copies timed out at 120s with the app stopped, then ran in 0.5s once it was launched, including immediately after a relaunch
result: link healthy, the 45s cap was the bug

decision: raised the probe copy bound to 150s and kept the sweep's pre-tap warm-up outside the settle clock
why: the bound exists to end a hang, so putting it under the slow-but-finite case converted recovery into a false stall

decision: discarded the first two sweep results and restarted from clip 1
why: clip 2 passed in the smoke run and stalled in the sweep, so the run's data was measuring the harness, not the product

decision: clip 1, a 1KB Dolby Vision HLS media segment, reproducibly lands Ready with no picture rather than reporting an error

result: recorded as a finding, not counted as a playback failure

decision: reverted my own widening of the immersive exit: it fires only for panorama and docked again

decision: stop the sweep with the controller's halt, never pkill
why: killing it mid-command leaves a runner holding the app, and the next ensure-session then times out at 600s fighting it

decision: a devicectl-launched app does not persist on visionOS, so its absence from the process list is not a crash
why: chased it as a launch crash until --console showed the app alive for 45s and ending only on my own SIGTERM
result: ruled out, the runner's launch is the only valid path

decision: abandoned my one-session sweep for the matrix's clean-open path over the same 92 clips
why: clip 2 stalled identically after the revert, so the shared session is the fragile part; the matrix re-establishes the session every cell, which is the robustness I traded away for speed
